title: Black Low Fire
description: Dark monochrome fire textures for Minecraft with a clean black-and-grey aesthetic, smooth pixel art, and vanilla-friendly design. Optimized for performance and compatible across multiple versions.
body: **BlackFire** — A clean minimalist Minecraft resource pack that transforms ordinary fire into a dark black-and-grey flame aesthetic. Designed with a smooth style, and a bold color vibe while keeping the vanilla feel coolDark. This 16x fire pack is optimised so that fps can't drop . Looks greater during PvP and gives a smooth dark new experience. As it is Low fire ,so it doesnt spoil view during fights.
